QuestInfo.name: Attack Training
QuestInfo.0: Ready for another training course from #b#p2151010##k? Talk to #b#p2151010##k at the #m310010010# in the Resistance Headquarters.
QuestInfo.1: This program is focused on honing attacks. Go inside the #b#m310010200##k and eliminate #r#o9300410#s#k within. Since #o9300410#s can self-destruct, you must strike quickly and forcefully.
QuestInfo.2: The second training course is behind you. #p2151010# might only be an amateur, but these courses aren't too shabby.

0.0: Next, we're going to work on your attack power. Sure, you'll learn new skills and crazy techniques, but your basic attacks are your bread and butter. You... DO eat bread and butter, right?

yes.0: Go to #b#m310010200##k and eliminate #r15 #o9300410#s#k. Sounds, simple, right? They're not your average robots, though.
yes.1: See, #r#o9300410#s#k can self-destruct. They'll explode exactly 10 seconds after you attack them, so you have to beat them fast. I want you to bring down 40 of them BEFORE they self-destruct. Think you can handle that?

no.0: You don't need to push yourself. Just take it slow and tackle it one step at a time, and you should be able to recover the strength that you've lost.

1.0: Ah, you've successfully eliminated the #o9300410#. Seems like you're on your way to recovery. Shall we ride this momentum and move on to the next course?

mob.0: You haven't defeated #r15 #o9300410#s#k yet. Take a break and try again, okay?
